Figure 6: Trade-off between Approximation Accuracy and Memory Cost. The Red solid line (Left Axis) shows the Pearson correlation between Тор-А and exact entropy, which saturates rapidly at 0.999. The Blue dashed line (Right Axis) tracks the additional memory overhead. The green shaded region highlights A = 20 as the optimal operating point, achieving near-perfect fidelity with negligible computational cost.
